name: insomnia-scripts

interface.shortDescription: Edit Insomnia scripts in git projects
interface.longDescription: Create or update pre-request and after-response scripts for requests and folders in an Insomnia git project. The skill edits the project's YAML files in your working tree and does not commit or push.
defaultPrompt: Add an after-response test to the Get orders request.
Set an auth token variable in a pre-request script.

description: Skills for working with Insomnia pre-request and after-response scripts in git projects.
